```python
def _compute_preds(self):
    topo=self.topo
    preds={}
    out_m={}; in_m={}
    for (s,d),v in self.demands.items():
        if not v: continue
        out_m[s]=out_m.get(s,0)+v
        in_m[d]=in_m.get(d,0)+v
    for a in topo.external:
        preds[(EXTERNAL,a)]=out_m.get(a,0)
        preds[(a,EXTERNAL)]=in_m.get(a,0)
    if self.paths_present:
        acc={}
        entries=self.route_entries
        for (s,d),v in self.demands.items():
            if not v: continue
            lst=entries.get((s,d))
            if not lst: continue
            for hops,w in lst:
                amt=v*w
                for h in hops:
                    acc[h]=acc.get(h,0)+amt
        for f in topo.internal_flows:
            preds[f]=acc.get(f,0)//1000
    return preds
```
